author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.29 shipped: Room lighting roles, darkness, manual hold, room switch, evening looks
summary: Room lighting roles, darkness, manual hold, room switch, evening looks
why: The operator called the room dialog the core of URA and a power-user mess: lighting roles were room-wide and misfiled in Devices, there was no way to exempt a light from the timeout, and URA could undo a light someone set by hand. Per-light roles in a behaviour step with one timeout keep the enumeration-vs-automation rule and add no new timers; four framing-disjoint reviews caught an evening-colour schema bug and an Away sweep that never fired before ship.
implications: Shipped ROOM-LIGHTING-SETUP-REDESIGN-1 at v5.103.29; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.29.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: If a hand-set light is turned off while the room is occupied, or Away leaves a leave-on light on with the option enabled, reopen.

refs.release_notes: Lighting step with per-light roles (on entry, only when dark, night lights, leave on when empty, alert lights); darkness from room sensor, borrowed sensor, Global Sensors outdoor light sensor, then the sun; URA no longer undoes a light you change by hand while you're in the room (hold ends when the room empties; caps are Advanced fields); a Room lights switch per room; Away turns off leave-on lights when the option is on; house Sleep picks night lights; optional evening brightness/colour or scene per room (Advanced). Absent new settings = today's behaviour, except rooms with no working light sensor now use outdoor light/sun for darkness.
